metadata.title: Nebula v2 — Coming soon
metadata.description: Super Mario Galaxy, with ray-traced lighting, smoother motion and more ways to play. Here’s what’s coming in the next update.

page.paragraph_2: Here’s what’s coming in the next update.

overview.paragraph_1: Nebula v2 runs Super Mario Galaxy as native code built from SMGCommunity’s Petari decompilation. You play the original levels, story and music from your own copy, with new options for how the game looks and feels.
overview.paragraph_2: v2 is coming soon. There is no announced release date yet. The current public download is v1.0.2; the features below describe the upcoming update.
overview.paragraph_3: Coming soon. Gameplay footage will be added here.

features.paragraph_1: Sunlight, shadows, reflections and water, with lamps, fire and Lumas lighting the world around them.
features.paragraph_2: Extra frames follow the game’s own motion, bringing smoother movement to 75, 120, 144, 165, 240 Hz and other displays.
features.paragraph_3: Internal resolution up to 16× and aspect ratios from 4:3 to 32:9, with sharp text and a HUD that fits your screen.
features.paragraph_4: Keyboard and mouse, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch controllers, Joy-Con, Steam controllers and a real Wii Remote with Nunchuk.
features.paragraph_5: Skip cutscenes, speed up dialogue and change settings from an in-game menu. Import Miis for your save-file icons.
features.paragraph_6: Import Riivolution mods, file replacements, Dolphin-format texture packs and HD movies from the Mods menu or by drag and drop.
features.paragraph_7: Track your progress with achievement pop-ups and a Luma’s board in the Comet Observatory, with goals and lifetime play stats.
features.paragraph_8: Import a Dolphin save, back up your progress and move saves through the launcher. Your current saves are backed up before an import.

comforts.item_1: Open settings from the pause menu or with F1. Graphics, controls, audio and mods are available without leaving the game.
comforts.item_2: Press + to skip supported cutscenes, tutorials and boss introductions. A confirmation appears before the skip.
comforts.item_3: Choose original, 2×, 3× or Instant dialogue speed, including the storybook.
comforts.item_4: Set separate music, effects, voices, ambience, cutscene and Wii Remote speaker volumes in Audio.
comforts.item_5: Import Miis for save-file icons and show your current galaxy and mission in Discord.
comforts.item_6: Export saves, import a Dolphin save, or restore a backup from the launcher.
comforts.item_7: Track 34 achievements and play statistics through a Luma’s board in the Observatory.

achievements.paragraph_1: v2 adds 34 achievements, with pop-ups as you earn them and a Luma in the Comet Observatory to show your progress. Here are the first three:
achievements.paragraph_2: Grab your very first Power Star.
achievements.paragraph_3: Feed a Hungry Luma until it transforms into a new galaxy.

platforms.heading_1: Windows first. More platforms in progress.
platforms.paragraph_1: The current release runs on 64-bit Windows 10 and 11.
platforms.paragraph_2: A native Vulkan version is in development. No public release date yet.
platforms.paragraph_3: Native support is being prepared. A public package has not been announced.
platforms.paragraph_4: An Android beta is released, with touch and controller support.
platforms.paragraph_5: An Apple silicon version is planned. No public release date yet.

upgrade.paragraph_1: Keep your supported game copy and export a save backup. Final release notes, requirements and upgrade steps will be linked here when v2 is available.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
